scope: Actual current human and animal source normalization, country chronology/provenance records and common DNA/pollen boundary contracts. No genotype, map/browser, LRA, propagation inference, taxonomy/rights or field admission.
csv_comparison: Exact byte equality, every row/column/order including27human and48animal fields
animal_summary_comparison: Complete JSON value equality with exact retained generation date
source_pointer_comparison: 60 literal normalized animal lineage/chronology pointers, original bytes and2named zip members. SRS1407451 transport metadata has no historical declared SHA; current bytes are frozen but not independently authenticated.
controlled_boundary_tests: Three maintained modules; actual source population replay is distinct from synthetic DNA/pollen domain controls.
criterion: ADNA-001 actual source lifecycle audit; no automatic closure of empirical PROP-004 or larger parent criteria.
